name: Message Status
description: Shows delivery and read receipts (checkmarks) on your messages, similar to WhatsApp and Telegram.

settings_schema.header: Message Status shows delivery and read receipts on your own messages.

settings.help_text: Height of the checkmarks on your messages. Between 6 and 20; smaller is more compact. Anything outside that range falls back to the default. Users need to reload the web client to pick up a change.

settings.display_name: Infer read receipts in channels from channel views
settings.help_text: Mobile and desktop apps cannot report reads, so without this a message read on a phone stays on one tick in channels. With it on, a member counts as having read a channel message once they open the channel after it arrived — which is weaker than actually scrolling to it. Direct messages always use this and are unaffected by this setting. Channels with more than 50 members are skipped for performance.
